heroLead: Pastor-led work across seven countries. Open a country to see what is happening there.

regions.name: East Africa
regions.lead: Kenya is the longest-running network. Tanzania, Rwanda, and Burundi are growing pastor cohorts from the same two-year journey.

regions.name: Horn of Africa
regions.lead: Ethiopia’s pastor network keeps working through difficult seasons — leadership training, farming, and new churches in Hossana, Gurage, and Durame.

regions.name: Southern Africa
regions.lead: Malawi has one of the largest pastor networks. Zambia is newer, with church and crop work spreading from Lusaka’s rural communities.
